scope: D2 comparison of fusion studies; focused reading, not a systematic review
method: Author paraphrases checked against the primary full texts or the explicitly limited primary abstract; copyrighted full texts are not redistributed

studies.read_level_this_stage: Full text reviewed for relevant claims
source_locators: Materials and methods: Study design and participants
Results: Radiomic feature selection and RadScore performance

facts.design: Single-center retrospective complete-case cohort with WHO grade 3 or 4 glioma
facts.endpoint: Pseudoprogression after radiotherapy; multidisciplinary longitudinal adjudication, with 13 histologically confirmed PsP cases and at least six months of stable or improved imaging for non-histological cases
facts.validation: Stratified 7:3 internal split; 155 training patients and 67 validation patients; authors report training-only filtering, scaling, feature selection and model estimation

studies.permitted_claim: Reported radiomics increment beyond a clinical-imaging baseline already containing advanced imaging and molecular information
studies.limits: Internal validation only; different inputs, endpoint and sampling from the present study. Do not claim an independently reproduced effect, transfer model coefficients, rank across-paper AUCs, or adopt biological interpretations from this report as established mechanisms.

studies.read_level_this_stage: Full text reviewed for relevant claims from previously acquired primary JATS XML
studies.source_snapshot_format: Previously acquired primary article JATS XML; live PMC browser check returned a verification page, so it was not treated as new full-text access
source_locators: Machine learning classification for distinguishing tumor versus pseudoprogression
RFE-RF classifier combining radiomics plus MGMT methylation to differentiate recurrent tumor versus pseudoprogression

facts.population: Adults with primary IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and repeat resection for an indeterminate enhancing lesion within a year after chemoradiotherapy
facts.endpoint: Repeat-surgery histopathology; any tumor classified as tumor, complete absence of tumor classified as pseudoprogression
facts.validation: Authors report five repetitions of nested three-fold cross-validation for the radiomics classifiers; no separate validation cohort

studies.permitted_claim: Reported higher cross-validation accuracy after adding MGMT to radiomics in a pathology-confirmed surgical cohort
studies.limits: The reported significant contrast concerns accuracy. Do not convert it into a proven significant AUC difference, claim uniform histology for our cohort, or call the published cross-validation an external validation. Do not assert all preprocessing was nested based only on the study's nested-validation label.

studies.read_level_this_stage: Primary indexed abstract and bibliographic record only
studies.permitted_claim: This related report uses the same named parent dataset, so it is not an independent confirmation of our findings
studies.limits: AJNR publisher full-text request returned HTTP 403. No full-text reading is claimed; do not infer exact participant overlap, detailed validation mechanics, or matched performance comparisons from the abstract.

interpretations.claim: The present broad treatment-related-change outcome is not a uniform pseudoprogression endpoint
interpretations.type: Comparison using the frozen reference-label protocol and the source studies' outcome definitions
